check_Type: check the current protobuf API implementation type by calling Type()
set_SetType: set the protobuf implementation type to cpp or python using _SetType()
get_Version: get the protobuf API implementation version number by calling Version()
check_IsPythonDefaultSerializationDeterm: check if Python default proto serialization is deterministic using IsPythonDefaultSerializationDeterministic()
review_api_implementation: review the protobuf API implementation module to understand implementation selection logic
